ground_truth_ejs_v500_sql:
/* Discern SQL Engine (EJS) v. 3.17.3: Adjustment_Transaction_Detail [7c178c1f-51f0-44a7-a50c-15efb08dfe7d] */
SELECT DISTINCT
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,
  CWF_RC_F_ADJUSTMENT.POST_DT_TM AS Adj_Post_Dt,
  CWF_RC_F_ADJUSTMENT.ADJUSTMENT_AMT AS Adj_Amount,
  RC_D_TRANSACTION_ALIAS.TRANS_SUB_TYPE_DESC AS Adj_Trans_Sub_Type,
  RC_D_TRANSACTION_ALIAS.TRANS_REASON_DESC AS Adj_Trans_Reason,
  RC_D_TRANSACTION_ALIAS.TRANS_ALIAS_TXT AS AdjTrans_Alias,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.FINANCIAL_CLASS_CD) AS Enc_Financial_Class
FROM V500.RC_F_ADJUSTMENT CWF_RC_F_ADJUSTMENT,
     V500.RC_D_TRANSACTION_ALIAS RC_D_TRANSACTION_ALIAS,
     V500.PFT_TRANS_RELTN PFT_TRANS_RELTN,
     V500.PFT_ENCNTR CWC_FINANCIAL_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON
WHERE CWF_RC_F_ADJUSTMENT.RC_D_TRANSACTION_ALIAS_ID = RC_D_TRANSACTION_ALIAS.RC_D_TRANSACTION_ALIAS_ID
  AND CWF_RC_F_ADJUSTMENT.ACTIVITY_ID = PFT_TRANS_RELTN.ACTIVITY_ID
  AND PFT_TRANS_RELTN.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = CWC_FINANCIAL_ENCOUNTER.PFT_ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_FINANCIAL_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWF_RC_F_ADJUSTMENT.ACTIVE_IND = 1
